name: @studio/audio-analysis
description: Producing the `{file}.cache` sidecar without the engine: decode with ffmpeg, build the peak/RMS/three-band envelope, detect onsets, estimate tempo. The arithmetic mirrors engine/st0-engine's Waveform.cpp, which is the other producer of the same file. Node-only, unlike @studio/audio-probe, which only MEASURES already-decoded audio. Consumed as source.
